name: Pokémon Adventures: Red Chapter
summary: Pokémon Adventures: Red Chapter is a Pokémon FireRed rom hack adapting the Pokémon Adventures/Special Manga. It follows the story of Red from Pallet Town as he embarks on his own Pokémon Journey. The story of this hack is divided into several distinct chapters across the Kanto region, the Orange Archipelago, and the beginning of the Elite Four. The remaining story will be completed in the follow-up RPG Maker PC game Pokémon: Special Chapter.
